message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It seems there's a misunderstanding. Brad's message says he's following up on a "previous message" and is asking if I've checked a "new list of times". I never received a previous message from him with a new list. The last thing I did was send *him* a list of times.

It's possible there was a system glitch and his first message didn't get through to me. I need to let him know I haven't received any list from him and that I'm waiting on his feedback on the list I sent.

I will formulate a clear message to Brad, explaining that I haven't received any list from him and that I'm waiting for him to check the times I provided.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, I haven't received any list of times from you. The last I see in the log is my message to you with a list of Priya's and Marcus's availability. I'm waiting for you to let me know which of those times work for Elena and David. Perhaps there was a glitch and your first message didn't come through? Let me know. Thanks, Alison"}
